Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 103. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You’ve learned to put the weight of a weapon to your
advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes.
You gain the following benefits:
On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a
melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points
with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as
a bonus action.
Before you make a melee attack with a heavy
weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose
to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack
hits, you add +10 to the attack’s damage.
